title: Remote test runs are visible in the local TermAl UI, and coordination of a remote run can resume from another remote session
outcome: Remote test runs are visible in the local TermAl UI, and coordination of a remote run can resume from another remote session
acceptance: A test run executed by a remote session appears in the local TermAl session and test-run UI with its run id, host, input, stage progress and terminal result, read from the remote session's notifications without a Central-side wait or index

If the coordinating remote session ends or becomes unavailable, coordination of an existing or finished remote run can resume from another remote session using the run's durable record; no running process is assumed to migrate between hosts
Tests cover the local projection of a remote run and the resume from another remote session
The change is reviewed and gated under the standing rule
